fit.objective_weights: 0.90 population + 0.10 conditional; each 0.90 station macro + 0.10 terminal-tree macro
fit.group_prior: equal mean-square prior capacity across source, soil_delivery, hydro and network_human groups
fit.optimizer: 160 AdamW steps then up to 200 strong-Wolfe L-BFGS iterations

fold_preprocessing: p01/p99 winsorization, centering and scaling learned only from unique training reaches and applied to evaluation reaches

temporal_gate.required: station and tree CI95 upper <0.005, with at least one CI95 upper <0
temporal_gate.offset_guard: maximum absolute transferable offset <=1 log unit; repeated exceedance is confounding
temporal_gate.conditional_guard: conditional layer must not be significantly worse than Parent
